clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Aelthalyste sends a Darkspear priest back to Orgrimmar. She sees that the young troll is ready for the tribe’s sacred rites, and Ur'kyo awaits in the Valley of Spirits.

Aelthalyste watches visiting troll priests in the Undercity. When an initiate has grown strong enough to face the tribe’s trials, she sends them across the Great Sea to learn from their own elders. She does not impose Forsaken teachings on them; their faith follows the traditions of their people.

In Orgrimmar’s Valley of Spirits, Ur'kyo tends to the Darkspear tribe’s spiritual needs and ancient rites. He welcomes the returning initiate and prepares them for a rite of passage. It joins the priest’s bond to the loa with spells that ward off harm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Like many of our own priests, your own tribe puts you through rites of passage. These rites often teach priests special abilities that are vital to their survival. I sense that time is upon you even as we speak. You must return to the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar and speak to Ur'kyo. What he teaches you might be very important for the future.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your rites will come soon enough. For now, I teach you a spell that will be of great use to you when you do battle with your enemies.
